import asyncio, django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models, connection

class Tag(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=10)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"

class Post(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=10)
    author = models.ForeignKey(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
    tags = models.ManyToManyField(Tag)
    class Meta:
        app_label = "auth"

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Tag)
    se.create_model(Post)

async def main():
    u = await User.objects.acreate(username="bob")
    # reverse FK related manager
    post = await u.post_set.acreate(title="p1")
    assert post.author_id == u.id, post.author_id
    p2, created = await u.post_set.aget_or_create(title="p2")
    assert created and p2.author_id == u.id
    p2b, created2 = await u.post_set.aget_or_create(title="p2")
    assert not created2 and p2b.id == p2.id
    p3, c3 = await u.post_set.aupdate_or_create(title="p2", defaults={"title": "p2x"})
    assert not c3 and p3.title == "p2x" and p3.author_id == u.id
    # m2m related manager
    t = await Tag.objects.acreate(name="t1")
    tag = await post.tags.acreate(name="t2")
    assert tag.name == "t2"
    tg, created = await post.tags.aget_or_create(name="t1")
    assert created
    tg2, created2 = await post.tags.aget_or_create(name="t1")
    assert not created2 and tg2.id == tg.id
    tu, cu = await post.tags.aupdate_or_create(name="t1", defaults={"name": "t1x"})
    assert not cu and tu.name == "t1x"
    # through_defaults path
    td, ctd = await post.tags.aget_or_create(name="t3", through_defaults={"tag": None}) if False else (None, None)
    print("ALL OK")

asyncio.run(main())
